verdict.rationale: The Snapdragon X2 Elite Extreme is a laptop processor (CPU and NPU silicon). Connecting an agent through an official MCP server is a software-service integration axis that does not apply to a chip. Nothing in the evidence shows the chip itself, as opposed to separate Qualcomm software services such as AI Hub, ships or serves an MCP endpoint. The probes found only a generic corporate llms.txt and no OpenAPI or markdown docs, so nothing flips the axis to applicable.
